name: kineglyph
description: Deterministic, themeable technical illustrations with motion and interaction.

scripts.pretest: npm run build --workspace @kineglyph/core && npm run build --workspace @kineglyph/svg && npm run build --workspace @kineglyph/anime && npm run build --workspace @kineglyph/scenes && npm run build --workspace @kineglyph/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @kineglyph/core && npm run build --workspace @kineglyph/svg && npm run build --workspace @kineglyph/anime && npm run build --workspace @kineglyph/scenes && npm run build --workspace @kineglyph/web && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
